notes.title: Card Creator master branch updated
notes.content:
Hi CardCreators !

The default master branch now has been updated with all the accumulated updates from the beta branch! Here is a recap of all the new updates!


[h3]✨ New Features[/h3]
[list][*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/523600/announcements/detail/3044964485195817183][2.15.0][/url] Add new guides shortcut in the start screen.
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/523600/announcements/detail/2897459630205599711][2.14.14][/url] [b]Allow to set the image filename format on export.[/b]
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/523600/announcements/detail/2868184881652346334][2.14.13][/url] New tool to rename automatically all your deck imported in TabletopSimulator.
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/523600/announcements/detail/2748838857184407747][2.14.12][/url] Add new recent projects menu in start screen.
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/523600/announcements/detail/2748838857184407747][2.14.12][/url] [b]Add new restore project from backup menu (context menu in collection screen).[/b]
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/523600/announcements/detail/2745459979763603897][2.14.11][/url] Add new menu to see all the log messages (toasts, etc) inside CardCreator.
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/523600/announcements/detail/2745459979763603897][2.14.11][/url] Add new Dutch translation (thanks to hopmanbd!).
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/523600/announcements/detail/2742081555259836728][2.14.10][/url] Show missing texture image when panel images can't load.
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/523600/announcements/detail/2742080922035377913][2.14.9][/url] [b]Ask for save when closing the application if there are unsaved changes.[/b]
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/523600/announcements/detail/2594586946435113271][2.14.8][/url] [b]Allow to export only the front or the back of the cards.[/b]
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/523600/announcements/detail/2594586946435113271][2.14.8][/url] [b]Allow to export fronts and backs in the same PDF (pages intercalated).[/b]
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/523600/announcements/detail/2594586946435113271][2.14.8][/url] Allow custom Tabletop Simulator (TTS) format (rows and columns).
[/list]

[h3]🔧 Improvements[/h3]
[list][*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/523600/announcements/detail/3044964485195817183][2.15.0][/url] Update new Pixelatto branding logo.
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/523600/announcements/detail/3044964485195817183][2.15.0][/url] Update guides URLs to the new guides webpage.

[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/523600/announcements/detail/2897459630205599711][2.14.14][/url] Save in project the new grid settings.
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/523600/announcements/detail/2868184881652346334][2.14.13][/url] Improve a lot the grid in blueprint screen.
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/523600/announcements/detail/2868184881652346334][2.14.13][/url] Change the date format in recent project selector window.
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/523600/announcements/detail/2745459979763603897][2.14.11][/url] Show missing texture image also when embeded icon images can't load.
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/523600/announcements/detail/2745459979763603897][2.14.11][/url] Improve missing texture using smaller squares.
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/523600/announcements/detail/2742081555259836728][2.14.10][/url] Autoselect the same panel when switching cards in card preview in card collection screen.
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/523600/announcements/detail/2742081555259836728][2.14.10][/url] Don't save text values for cardsets when the panel text is equal to its blueprint.
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/523600/announcements/detail/2742080922035377913][2.14.9][/url] Text panel values now defaults to the blueprint value when editing in the collection screen.
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/523600/announcements/detail/2742080922035377913][2.14.9][/url] Save the new export options of the previous update in the project settings.
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/523600/announcements/detail/2742080922035377913][2.14.9][/url] Improved number and vector inputs invalid values handling.
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/523600/announcements/detail/2594586946435113271][2.14.8][/url] Render border material in front of images (not in the back).
[/list]

[h3]🐛 Bugfixes[/h3]
[list][*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/523600/announcements/detail/3044964485195817183][2.15.0][/url] Fix MagicalDeck sample project white panels.

[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/523600/announcements/detail/2868184881652346334][2.14.13][/url] Fix minus character handling in input fields.
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/523600/announcements/detail/2868184881652346334][2.14.13][/url] Fix icon panel repeating in a pattern.
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/523600/announcements/detail/2868184881652346334][2.14.13][/url] Fix CSV parser when EOF is just after a quoted field.
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/523600/announcements/detail/2868184881652346334][2.14.13][/url] Fix legacy project XML deserializer.
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/523600/announcements/detail/2745459979763603897][2.14.11][/url] Fix Excel/CSV import not working when another program (like Office) has the file opened.
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/523600/announcements/detail/2745459979763603897][2.14.11][/url] Fix RePag card order on collection screen.
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/523600/announcements/detail/2742081555259836728][2.14.10][/url] Fix prompt asking for unsaved changes when on main menu screen.
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/523600/announcements/detail/2742081555259836728][2.14.10][/url] Fix minimum blueprint layout size value in any axis to 1.
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/523600/announcements/detail/2742081555259836728][2.14.10][/url] Fix rare bug when card text editing in card collection screen.
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/523600/announcements/detail/2742081555259836728][2.14.10][/url] Fix text copy between panels by value.
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/523600/announcements/detail/2742080922035377913][2.14.9][/url] Fix card rendering when using bleeding in PDF export.
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/523600/announcements/detail/2742080922035377913][2.14.9][/url] Fix massive cards occluding export screen UI.
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/523600/announcements/detail/2594586946435113271][2.14.8][/url] Fix some german translations.
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/523600/announcements/detail/2594586946435113271][2.14.8][/url] Fix some buttons showing with capital letters.
[/list]




If you have feedback or want to report an issue, please join to our Discord server: [url=http://discord.gg/pixelatto]http://discord.gg/pixelatto[/url]


All those updates are already in the [b][u]master[/u][/b] branch. If you want to use an older app version, you can learn [url=https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1129108624]how to change to a beta or legacy branch in steam here[/url].

notes.title: Card Creator latest updates recap
notes.content:
Hi CardCreators !

In the latest months there were some important changes to the app, [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/523600/announcements/detail/3484040172292317481]the project format was reworked[/url] and the long awaited support to [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/523600/announcements/detail/2215152154590302063]import/export from/to Excel & CSV[/url] was finally added alongside more features and bugfixes. Here is a recap of all the new updates!


[h3]New Features[/h3]
[list][*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/523600/announcements/detail/3757636398648442358][2.14.0][/url] Reintroduced image scaling and offset for embedded images in text panels.
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/523600/announcements/detail/3757636398648442358][2.14.0][/url] Added scaling and offset settings for image variables editor.
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/523600/announcements/detail/3757636398648442358][2.14.0][/url] [b]Added Swedish language[/b] (thanks to [b]Lemshimmer[/b]!).
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/523600/announcements/detail/2215152154590302063][2.13.0][/url] [b]Import and export data from/to Excel files.[/b]
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/523600/announcements/detail/2215152154590302063][2.13.0][/url] [b]Import and export data from/to CSV files.[/b]
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/523600/announcements/detail/2214025621601456250][2.12.4][/url] Add new material type to make colored panel borders.
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/523600/announcements/detail/3484040172292317481][2.12.3][/url] [b]New project save format based on JSON files.[/b]
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/523600/announcements/detail/3484040172292317481][2.12.3][/url] Per project icon gallery folders support.
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/523600/announcements/detail/3484040172292317481][2.12.3][/url] Automatic backups each 5 minutes if there are unsaved changes.
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/523600/announcements/detail/3484040172292317481][2.12.3][/url] The export config and zoom value in card collection screen will be saved per project.
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/523600/announcements/detail/3484040172292317481][2.12.3][/url] [b]All images referenced outside of the project folder will be copied on project save.[/b]
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/523600/announcements/detail/3484040172292317481][2.12.3][/url] App log will be saved to the project temp folder on app close.
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/523600/announcements/detail/2099181293468649147][2.11.0][/url] Move cards between sets using the same [b]linked[/b] blueprint.
[/list]

[h3]Improvements[/h3]
[list][*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/523600/announcements/detail/3757636398648442358][2.14.0][/url] Improved language selector dropdown in start screen.
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/523600/announcements/detail/3757636398648442358][2.14.0][/url] Simplify tabletop simulator export filename format.
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/523600/announcements/detail/3757636398648442358][2.14.0][/url] Improved rotation serialization for collections.
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/523600/announcements/detail/3757636398648442358][2.14.0][/url] Improved image paths serialization updating fullpaths not using the %PROJECT% tag.
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/523600/announcements/detail/2198264290008899303][2.13.1][/url] Add missing translations.
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/523600/announcements/detail/2198264290008899303][2.13.1][/url] Add cache system to loaded fonts.
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/523600/announcements/detail/2198264290008899303][2.13.1][/url] Show on top the custom fonts used in the project in font dropdown selector.
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/523600/announcements/detail/2198264290008899303][2.13.1][/url] Change field label name to panel name.
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/523600/announcements/detail/2215152154590302063][2.13.0][/url] Updated all sample projects and default blueprint.
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/523600/announcements/detail/2214025621601456250][2.12.4][/url] Increase scrollbar size in blueprint selection modal prompt.
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/523600/announcements/detail/3484040172292317481][2.12.3][/url] [b]Exports will use the new output folder, not need to set manually the path/name.[/b]
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/523600/announcements/detail/3484040172292317481][2.12.3][/url] Export folder will open automatically in the file explorer when the export is finished.
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/523600/announcements/detail/3484040172292317481][2.12.3][/url] [b]The image file browser will open on the correct contextual folder for each type of image.[/b]
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/523600/announcements/detail/3484040172292317481][2.12.3][/url] Project icon gallery categories will appear on top in the icon selector widget.
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/523600/announcements/detail/3484040172292317481][2.12.3][/url] Each blueprint and each cardset is now a separate data file in JSON.
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/523600/announcements/detail/3484040172292317481][2.12.3][/url] Add toast message and debug log when a font isn't found in the system.
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/523600/announcements/detail/3484040172292317481][2.12.3][/url] Updated all sample projects and default blueprint to the new format.
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/523600/announcements/detail/3484040172292317481][2.12.3][/url] Simplified start menu screen.
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/523600/announcements/detail/3484040172292317481][2.12.3][/url] Remove fullscreen mode by default on app first launch.
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/523600/announcements/detail/3484040172292317481][2.12.3][/url] Log files older than 3 days will be deleted automatically.
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/523600/announcements/detail/3484040172292317481][2.12.3][/url] Changed some error log messages to debug messages (missing assets).
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/523600/announcements/detail/3484040172292317481][2.12.3][/url] Remove stacktraces for debug log messages to reduce log file sizes.
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/523600/announcements/detail/1817705682833698757][2.10.1][/url] Add support for decimal numbers in outline distance and allow smaller values.
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/523600/announcements/detail/1817705682833698757][2.10.1][/url] Remove dropdown fade in & out animations.
[/list]

[h3]Bugfixes[/h3]
[list][*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/523600/announcements/detail/2198265556937462729][2.14.1][/url] Fix embeded images and icons size on exported images.
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/523600/announcements/detail/2198265556937462729][2.14.1][/url] [b]Fix card sets fold status on collection screen.[/b]
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/523600/announcements/detail/2198265556937462729][2.14.1][/url] Fix image local path loading when using some special characters.
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/523600/announcements/detail/2198265556937462729][2.14.1][/url] Fix outline color value when copying between panels.
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/523600/announcements/detail/2198265556937462729][2.14.1][/url] Fix interface white text on white background in icon selector.
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/523600/announcements/detail/2198264290008899303][2.13.1][/url] Fix json blueprints and cardsets not being deleted when removed from the project.
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/523600/announcements/detail/2198264290008899303][2.13.1][/url] Fix embeded image in variables editor missing image error.
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/523600/announcements/detail/2198264290008899303][2.13.1][/url] Fix invisible options in font dropwdown selector.
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/523600/announcements/detail/2215152154590302063][2.13.0][/url] [b]Fix project name not being saved.[/b]
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/523600/announcements/detail/2215152154590302063][2.13.0][/url] Fix cardset not rendering on rare cases.
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/523600/announcements/detail/2215152154590302063][2.13.0][/url] Fix font not using fallback when not defined in cardset panels.
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/523600/announcements/detail/2215152154590302063][2.13.0][/url] Fix embedded image scaling values being ignored.
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/523600/announcements/detail/2214025621601456250][2.12.4][/url] Fix rotation not working in some panels.
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/523600/announcements/detail/3484040172292317481][2.12.3][/url] Fix TabletTop Simulator skewed image export.
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/523600/announcements/detail/3484040172292317481][2.12.3][/url] [b]Fix fonts being reset to the default value when they can't load for some reason.[/b]
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/523600/announcements/detail/3484040172292317481][2.12.3][/url] Fix error when opening the export screen when there are no cards in the project.
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/523600/announcements/detail/2099181293482710722][2.11.2][/url] Fix card alignment bug when saving blueprint changes.
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/523600/announcements/detail/2099181293468858066][2.11.1][/url] Fix Tabletop Simulator export when using some card aspect ratios.
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/523600/announcements/detail/2099181293468649147][2.11.0][/url] Fix project name not being saved.
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/523600/announcements/detail/2099181293468649147][2.11.0][/url] Fix project export button when export path is set.
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/523600/announcements/detail/1817705682833698757][2.10.1][/url] [b]Fix file names for PDF and tabletop export files.[/b]
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/523600/announcements/detail/1817705682833698757][2.10.1][/url] Fix export button canceling the export after selecting the destination path folder.
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/523600/announcements/detail/1817705682833698757][2.10.1][/url] Fix rare bug where some text panels in blueprint mode were not showing up.
[*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/523600/announcements/detail/1817705682833698757][2.10.1][/url] Remove embedded images scaling and offset inputs in blueprint and card editors.
[/list]




If you have feedback or want to report an issue, please join to our Discord server: [url=http://discord.gg/pixelatto]http://discord.gg/pixelatto[/url]

notes.title: New Update (2.13.0) - "Excel & CSV support"
notes.content:
Hi CardCreators !

The long awaited import & export feature is finally here! You can now import and export data from/to your cardsets and between projects. This feature has been made to be flexible so it can adapt to your own workflow and needs. [b]Please read more about this update below after the changelog.[/b]

[h3]New Features[/h3]
[list][*] Import and export data from/to Excel files.
[*] Import and export data from/to CSV files.
[/list]

[h3]Improvements[/h3]
[list][*] Updated all sample projects and default blueprint.
[/list]

[h3]Bugfixes[/h3]
[list][*] Fix project name not being saved.
[*] Fix cardset not rendering on rare cases.
[*] Fix font not using fallback when not defined in cardset panels.
[*] Fix embedded image scaling values being ignored.
[/list]


[h2]Import/export data from/to Excel & CSV[/h2]

First,  you need to define the panels you want to import or export its data. To do that, go to the blueprint mode and open the Advanced options in the panel, then write a field label. That label will be used to identify the data as columns in the Excel / CSV.

Also, very important, if you want to import data and update cards (not only add them), you need to define a way to identify each card, to do so, you need to check the "Card ID" toggle On in the panel you want to be the ID of that card.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28448748/b214491af6d8a4624b31a3dfd094d4fe833bdec0.png[/img]

Once you have defined the panel names, you are ready to export or import your data! Go to the dropdowns in the navbar or the cardset. You can only export one cardset per CSV file (since they don't have "worksheets" as Excels do). You can import Excels in either XLSX or XLSM format (the old XLS format is not supported).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28448748/0894a35c391feff5be6bd40e5c33bffc4de01640.png[/img]

The first row (either in CSV or Excel worksheets) will always contain the panel names.

Optionally, if you name the [b]first[/b] column "amount", that column will be used as the amount of that card on import. On export that column will be always created in addition of the other panel columns.

The worksheet names in Excels will be composed by the blueprint name + cardset name separated by the character [b]@[/b]. When importing, the worksheet names should have the same format, example:

[code]blueprintName@cardSetName[/code]

In addition, you need to keep in mind some limitations of the Excel format:
[list][*] Worksheet names max length is 31 characters.
[*]Worksheet names can't have any of the following chars [b][ ] * / \\ ? :[/b]
[/list]
Worksheet those names doesn't follow this format [b]will be ignored on import[/b].

When importing Excels, the blueprint name (in the worksheet name) [b]needs to match an existing blueprint in the project[/b].

If the cardset name is found already in the project it [u]will update or add the new cards on import[/u], if not, [u]a new cardset will be created[/u] with that name in the project.



That's all ! Hope you enjoy the new feature :)

notes.title: New Update (2.12.3) - "New Project Format"
notes.content:
Hi CardCreators !

This new update features a new project format, more open and future-proof for all the upgrades that will come to the app. [b]You can read more about this update below after the changelog[/b].

[h3]New Features[/h3]
[list][*] [b]New project save format based on JSON files.[/b]
[*] Per project icon gallery folders support.
[*] Automatic backups each 5 minutes if there are unsaved changes.
[*] The export config and zoom value in card collection screen will be saved per project.
[*] [b]All images referenced outside of the project folder will be copied on project save.[/b]
[*] App log will be saved to the project temp folder on app close.
[/list]

[h3]Improvements[/h3]
[list][*] [b]Exports will use the new output folder, not need to set manually the path/name each time.[/b]
[*] Export folder will open automatically in the file explorer when the export is finished.
[*] [b]The image file browser will open on the correct contextual folder for each type of image.[/b]
[*] Project icon gallery categories will appear on top in the icon selector widget.
[*] Each blueprint and each cardset is now a separate data file in JSON.
[*] Add toast message and debug log when a font isn't found in the system.
[*] Updated all sample projects and default blueprint to the new format.
[*] Simplified start menu screen.
[*] Remove fullscreen mode by default on app first launch.
[*] Log files older than 3 days will be deleted automatically.
[*] [Internal] Changed some error log messages to debug messages (missing assets).
[*] [Internal] Remove stacktraces for debug log messages to reduce log file sizes.
[/list]

[h3]Bugfixes[/h3]
[list][*] Fix TabletTop Simulator skewed image export.
[*] Fix fonts being reset to the default value when they can't load for some reason.
[*] Fix error when opening the export screen when there are no cards in the project.
[/list]


[u][h2]The new project format[/h2][/u]
The main target with the new format is to bring all the data that compose a project into a single project folder so you have everything in one place.

Here is a diagram showing a summary of the new project folder structure:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28448748/e236e74acbfe6fcafdcf80e92fe6a8ad05932bec.png[/img]

[b]IMPORTANT[/b]: Please take note that [u]the new project format [b]CAN'T[/b] be opened in previous versions of the program[/u].

[h3]When converting a legacy project:[/h3]
[list][*] [b]A backup of the original .cc file will be created in the [i]/backups/[/i] folder.[/b]
[*] The new project format folder will be created (if doesn't exist) replacing the legacy .cc file.
[*] All the older legacy backups will be copied into the [i]/backups/[/i] folder.
[*] All images referenced will be [b]COPIED[/b] to the [i]/assets/images/[/i] folder.
[*] All the embeded images will be extracted and stored in the [i]/assets/images_inline/[/i] folder.
[/list]

[h3]Here there are some highlights of the new format:[/h3]
[list][*] All the project data is stored as JSON files in the [i]/data/[/i] folder.
[*] Each blueprint and each cardset is now a separate file.
[*] All the backups of the project are in the [i]/backups/[/i] folder.
[*] The project supports it's own image gallery using folders inside the [i]/assets/icon_gallery/[/i] folder.
[*] The new backup files are simple ZIP files containing all the JSON data files in [i]/data/[/i] folder.
[*] All the timestamps for the backups, output or log files are in UTC.
[*] When exporting a new set of files will be created in a new folder inside the [i]/output/[/i] folder.
[*] The [i]/output/[/i], [i]/backups/[/i] and [i]/temp/[/i] folders can be safely deleted, the app will recreate them when needed.
[/list]

[h3]For advanced users:[/h3]
[list][*] You should be able to copy easily blueprint JSON files between projects.
[*] You can also copy cardset JSON files between projects, but make sure that the used blueprint GUID exists in the target project or it won't work.
[*] The new JSON format is more readable and programmer-friendly and thus it should be easier to manipulate either by hand or by a custom tool.
[*] The new format is also very friendly with version-control systems like Git (in fact, some files like .gitignore and .gitattributes are autogenerated for you, you can safely modify or delete them if you want).
[/list]


That's all, we are working hard to bring more features in the following updates like the highly anticipated CSV/Excel support.

notes.title: New Update (2.9.0) - "Relative paths for images and more layers"
notes.content:
Hi, CardCreators!

With this update, we wanted to address the problem with the projects not being very flexible because they stored all paths as absolute, so if you moved the image or project (.cc) files to another folder, the image references were broken.
[b]Not anymore[/b]! You can read more at the bottom about this new feature.

We also doubled the max layer count (previously was 8 layers), so you are more capable of creating more complex cards without reaching limits.

In addition, we knew using the rich text input editor was a bit odd, so we improved it moving all the format buttons below of the text input. The text being edited now shows the format keywords too, so you can copy and paste values with the format easily.

The update also features several bugfixes and stability changes. Hope the program is more robust than ever !

Hope you enjoy it!



[h3]New Features[/h3]
[list][*] Add relative paths support loading image files (keyword: [b]%PROJECT%[/b]). Read more below.
[*] Increased max layer count by 8 (now is 16 layers).
[*] New StartFantasia sample project.
[/list]

[h3]Improvements[/h3]
[list][*] Improved Rich Text fields moving the format buttons on top of the text fields.
[*] Now you will see the format special characters in rich text fields (easier to copy and paste outside of the program).
[*] Removed old files to reduce by 48 MB less the app size.
[*] Added scroll where there are layer lists to handle longer lists.
[*] Updated sample projects images to use the new relative links.
[*] Removed weird card resizing animations when changing the window app size.
[*] Replaced the internal system to open the windows file browser.
[/list]

[h3]Bugfixes[/h3]
[list][*] Fix text not being rendering properly (wrong size) when opening blueprint mode for second time.
[*] Fix copy and paste not working in card edit view on collections
[*] Fix field label input being of type rich text, now is a normal text field.
[*] Fix error when removing the first card in a cart set on thumbnail mode.
[*] Fix error when removing the last card in a card set (when there is only one left).
[*] Fix fading effect on layer hide/show animation.
[*] Updated some French translation terms.
[/list]



[b]New relative path keyword[/b]:

First of all, [b]Card Creator will use automatically the new keyword if the image being referenced is in the same folder or in a subfolder where the .cc is saved[/b], so, [u]remember to save first the project before adding images if the project is new[/u]!.

Also, if you want to reference a image in a parent folder but using the new keyword anyways, you can use it if you put double points to reference the parent folder.

Examples: [code]%PROJECT%\\..\\image_in_parent_folder.png[/code]  [code]%PROJECT%\\..\\..\\image_in_parent_folder_of_parent_folder.png[/code]

notes.content:
Hi, CardCreators!

We started this update to be only a small hotfix/update for the rendering, but turned out to be a bigger update with lots of improvements that will ease your experience creating cards.
Because of the nature of the update we needed to do some breaking changes that will change how your cards are rendering now to match how you create them in blueprint mode.

It's possible you need also to update the padding of your panels if you did use them (see changelog below). This update is released in the [b][u]beta[/u][/b] branch (see below at the bottom for more info).

Hope you enjoy it!

[*] Fix padding values (now are consistent). Values are in percentage of the panel, before it was the percentage of the distance for the shorter side of the panel.

notes.title: Card Creator 2.0
notes.content:
After months of hard work, we are proud to introduce you to the new Card Creator! We gathered a huge deal of feedback from the initial version and worked since to deliver a completely re-imagined version.

[h1][b][u]New features[/u][/b][/h1]

[h1]Blueprint editor[/h1]

The most requested feature overall was to be able to completely customize the design of the cards. Our response is the "blueprint editor", a completely new tool that allows you to define any kind of card format (blueprint) you can imagine and use it as a template to quickly create all the cards you want with it. Split your card into as many areas you like and assign each one with one of the panel types (text, image or icon for now, more are coming).

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28448748/c6ee57ef6d84315852190d0311a37e7c0736af92.gif[/img]

[h1]Card editor[/h1]

Once you have your format defined, you can instantiate as many cards as you like and edit the contents of each one. Click over a text piece to edit it, over an image to re-assign it, or over an icon to pick one from the new icon gallery with tons of new icons and re-organized categories.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28448748/727737e6b6c28d685583c5c421fe97914b594b57.gif[/img]

[h1]Collection editor[/h1]

The new collection editor is no longer a card list with a single preview, but a complete array of your cards as if they were placed over the table, all with realtime previews responding to any format or content changes. We've also added the much requested card sets, so you can arrange the cards in your collection into many different sets, each one with its own (or shared) blueprint.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28448748/87e8e247787abf5261d1592208bb00892ddff176.gif[/img]

[h1]Layers, format grid, card size, bleeding, back side edit, UX improvements[/h1]

We've added multiple layers to the blueprint editor in case you need more control for advanced formats, full edge bleeding support for print & play prototypes, back side edit and export and many other features.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28448748/6f2b29eed03134981e600f0892d0c4737e29bb4e.gif[/img]

[h1]Output[/h1]

We've revamped the output screen completely. Now it's easier to know how your collection will be printed with just a glance. You may also choose your paper format and orientation.The output pdf even includes cut lines and is aligned so you'll be able to easily print the back of your cards. 

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28448748/a05f952e9b5539309baf2e7750a3ef8f1c611fb0.gif[/img]

[h1][b][u]Version notes[/u][/b][/h1]

[h1]Please be kind[/h1]

We did a lot of testing before releasing this version but errors may happen. The first days after we'll patch any reported bugs and start working on the next update (this one wont take that long...).

[h1]Roadmap[/h1]

If you want to know what's next, be sure to check out our feature roadmap at: 
https://trello.com/b/WxLZOIDR/card-creator
We update this on a daily basis since it works also as our to-do list.

[h1]Legacy version[/h1]

If you are currently working on a project with the previous version of Card Creator, we've enabled a legacy version so you can keep using your projects. This format will no longer be supported in newer versions.

You may find out more about opting in for this version in [url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=182912431]this post[/url], under "Product Betas". You'll find the previous version of CardCreator as "[b]legacy[/b]".

[h1]2.0 Changelog[/h1]

[u]General[/u]
[list]
[*]Completely redesigned UI/UX
[*]Tons of bugfixes
[*]Added sample projects
[*]Merged different files into a single project file
[*]Smooth UI animations everywhere
[/list]

[u]Blueprints[/u]
[list]
[*]Split/merge multi-tool to enable arbitrary layout creation
[*]Radial menu tool to enable quick panel type assignation
[*]Multi layer support
[*]Support to edit back side of the cards
[*]Replaced old fixed format with a generic new one
[*]Text fields with font, alignment and color support
[*]Image fields, with masking, positioning and zoom support
[*]Blueprint management
[*]Overlay grid, snap to grid and variable grid size
[/list]

[u]Collections & Cards[/u]
[list]
[*]New realtime preview generator (much faster!)
[*]Drag & drop support to reorder cards
[*]Card amount input for multiple instanced cards
[*]New collection format, with multiple sets per collection support
[*]Card set zoom in/out slider to display more or less cards
[*]Hundreds of new icons to the icon picker
[*]Rearranged icon categories
[*]Flip card preview upside-down
[/list]

[u]Output[/u]
[list]
[*]Realtime PDF/print previews

notes.title: Card Creator 2.0
notes.content:
After months of hard work, we are proud to introduce you to the new Card Creator! We gathered a huge deal of feedback from the initial version and worked since to deliver a completely re-imagined version.

[h1][b][u]New features[/u][/b][/h1]

[h1]Blueprint editor[/h1]

The most requested feature overall was to be able to completely customize the design of the cards. Our response is the "blueprint editor", a completely new tool that allows you to define any kind of card format (blueprint) you can imagine and use it as a template to quickly create all the cards you want with it. Split your card into as many areas you like and assign each one with one of the panel types (text, image or icon for now, more are coming).

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28448748/c6ee57ef6d84315852190d0311a37e7c0736af92.gif[/img]

[h1]Card editor[/h1]

Once you have your format defined, you can instantiate as many cards as you like and edit the contents of each one. Click over a text piece to edit it, over an image to re-assign it, or over an icon to pick one from the new icon gallery with tons of new icons and re-organized categories.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28448748/727737e6b6c28d685583c5c421fe97914b594b57.gif[/img]

[h1]Collection editor[/h1]

The new collection editor is no longer a card list with a single preview, but a complete array of your cards as if they were placed over the table, all with realtime previews responding to any format or content changes. We've also added the much requested card sets, so you can arrange the cards in your collection into many different sets, each one with its own (or shared) blueprint.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28448748/87e8e247787abf5261d1592208bb00892ddff176.gif[/img]

[h1]Layers, format grid, card size, bleeding, back side edit, UX improvements[/h1]

We've added multiple layers to the blueprint editor in case you need more control for advanced formats, full edge bleeding support for print & play prototypes, back side edit and export and many other features.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28448748/6f2b29eed03134981e600f0892d0c4737e29bb4e.gif[/img]

[h1]Output[/h1]

We've revamped the output screen completely. Now it's easier to know how your collection will be printed with just a glance. You may also choose your paper format and orientation.The output pdf even includes cut lines and is aligned so you'll be able to easily print the back of your cards. 

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28448748/a05f952e9b5539309baf2e7750a3ef8f1c611fb0.gif[/img]

[h1][b][u]Version notes[/u][/b][/h1]

[h1]Please be kind[/h1]

We did a lot of testing before releasing this version but errors may happen. The first days after we'll patch any reported bugs and start working on the next update (this one wont take that long...).

[h1]Roadmap[/h1]

If you want to know what's next, be sure to check out our feature roadmap at: 
https://trello.com/b/WxLZOIDR/card-creator
We update this on a daily basis since it works also as our to-do list.

[h1]Legacy version[/h1]

If you are currently working on a project with the previous version of Card Creator, we've enabled a legacy version so you can keep using your projects. This format will no longer be supported in newer versions.

You may find out more about opting in for this version in [url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=182912431]this post[/url], under "Product Betas". You'll find the previous version of CardCreator as "[b]legacy[/b]".

notes.title: New Design Updates
notes.content:
Hi you all, CardCreators!

We would like to bring some updates about the stuff we are working on these days. 

As you know, we take your feedback very seriously and try to meet all your request as soon as possible. We've been collecting your suggestions and we've designed the new interface of CardCreator around them, trying to make it versatile, fun and easy to use at the same time. 

I'm here today to share with you some of this progress and hopefully collect some more feedback based on what you can see in this post. 

[h1]Split Editor[/h1]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28448748/5431ea194d76fa573f7e5f3e9ba0e6bffa2bba75.gif[/img]

We came up with a new way to design the layout of your cards: the split tool. With this tool you can simply cut any panel to create a new field next to it. This lets you create a blueprint really fast while keeping the design tidy and organized.

[h1]Panel Content[/h1]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28448748/bbd52c9adbc65dac6b8941356f4beed3721a6ca9.gif[/img]

Now you'll be free to arrange the fields' content of your card exactly the way you want. No restrictions here.

[h1]Card Redimension[/h1]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28448748/2b2a58a8dd0483351c263e1c0c433e909b3b110e.gif[/img]

Many of you have asked for a way to define the size of your cards with absolute values instead of having to deal with the, sometimes abstract, aspect ratio. Here's our proposal.

[h1]Layers[/h1]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28448748/a107702df4427546ce087b2cb31a07553f2f8e9f.gif[/img]

In case you have in mind a very intrincate design, the app will allow you to work with layers to easily organize and overlap your panels. 

[h1]Customization[/h1]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28448748/f6aedff5a4f59f92c838b49758033bb28bc54bc1.gif[/img]

Every content type will expose some custom fields, including default values, to help you make the coolest card collection in a matter of minutes. 

Well, that's all for now. We hope you like the path we're taking for this upcoming huge update ;)

Feel free to comment anything that might come to your mind.
